ic_name: IEEE 1149.1 JTAG TAP Controller (TI SSYA002C primer)
test_cases_present: partial — the primer defines the architectural rules, FSM transition table, mandatory / optional instructions, and a Suggested Design-for-Test Flow (Chapter 6) + Applications chapter (Chapter 7) but does not provide a formal test bench. The categories below are the spec-derived compliance test scenarios.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
